summary: Deploy the new Saleor version with a state-only Django migration so the schema stays unchanged while both versions run in parallel; retire the old version; then drop the note column from account_user in a contract SQL stage. This keeps the column intact during the overlap where the old version continues to write notes, and removes it safely after the old version is gone.
write_consistency: While both versions are live, the old version includes note in its INSERT/UPDATE statements and the new version ignores the column; the database column retains all recently written values. After retire_old, the column is dropped with no risk of the old version overwriting it.

stages.description: No-op expand stage to satisfy the staged-rollout requirement; column state is unchanged.
Retire the old Saleor version so it no longer serves traffic.
Drop the note column from the account_user table now that the old version is retired.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user DROP COLUMN note;
